question: If SNAKE is written as RMZJD, how is ZEBRA written.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: Each letter is shifted **two positions backward** in the English alphabet.

Given, SNAKE → R M Z J D

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a9c59cea75b0b349c9a7187c721e7412c3446ad385b4a01aa4a021a9db0e9bc.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7774221b54dfaf1e8414d363442e0e64f11a5fcc867792ff90067ab6ec57ce02.png] 

Now, Z E B R A :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50307e8a35eeefcc32e5dedc33ee3be0909e588a9050b1c33129299b0e9cc9f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/508e94b160ad2994febee32b8f2e84826d563b38ccd7a184b1f1328c49015571.png] 

So, ZEBRA → Y D A Q Z

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
